Message.Name: Statistics Message
Message.Description: The Statistics message provides statistics including volume-weighted average price and turnover. Generated (excluding overseas trades) once after CTS/auction match, manual trade, odd lot trade, or trade cancel. VWAP is not populated for SS (OMD Securities Standard) clients.

Field.Name: SecurityCode
Field.Description: Uniquely identifies a security available for trading.

Field.Name: SharesTraded
Field.Description: Number of shares traded for a security.

Field.Name: HighPrice
Field.Description: Highest trade price currently performed for a security. 3 implied decimal places.

Field.Name: LowPrice
Field.Description: Lowest trade price currently performed for a security. 3 implied decimal places.

Field.Name: LastPrice
Field.Description: Last trade price for a security. 3 implied decimal places.

Field.Name: VWAP
Field.Description: Volume-Weighted Average Price. 3 implied decimal places.

Field.Name: ShortSellSharesTraded
Field.Description: Number of short-sell shares traded for a security.

Field.Name: ShortSellTurnover
Field.Description: Current short-sell turnover for a security. 3 implied decimal places.

Message.Name: Market Turnover Message
Message.Description: The Market Turnover message contains the total turnover (excluding overseas trades) for all securities on a given market segment for a given trading currency. When CurrencyCode is blank, the turnover represents the total for all trading currencies, expressed in HKD. Updates disseminated around every 2 seconds during trading hours.

Field.Name: CurrencyCode
Field.Description: Currency code of all securities of which the market turnover is derived. Blank for total turnover for the Market Segment in HKD equivalent.

Field.Name: Turnover
Field.Description: Total Traded Turnover of the stocks traded on the market segment in the respective currency. 3 implied decimal places.

Message.Name: Yield Message
Message.Description: The Yield message is generated for bond securities when their yield percentage changes.

Field.Name: SecurityCode
Field.Description: Uniquely identifies a security available for trading.

Field.Name: Yield
Field.Description: Current yield of the bond security based on its coupon rate and nominal price. 3 implied decimal places. 0 means Not available.
